name: Yogg-Saron's Embrace grants +10% attack power and +10% max mana through native unconditional auras (#1828)
contract: 301984 is a passive with two effects that read no classmask (both native handlers ignore EffectSpellClassMask, so no target-spell match is needed). Effect[0]: Aura 166 = SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_PCT, BasePoints 9+1=+10%; AuraEffect::HandleAuraModAttackPowerPercent (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5103) unconditionally calls SetStatPctModifier(UNIT_MOD_ATTACK_POWER, TOTAL_PCT, ...). Effect[1]: Aura 132 = SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_ENERGY_PERCENT, EffectMiscValue=0=POWER_MANA, BasePoints 9+1=+10%; AuraEffect::HandleAuraModIncreaseEnergyPercent (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4693) reads Powers(GetMiscValue()) and calls ApplyStatPctModifier(UNIT_MOD_POWER_START+POWER_MANA, TOTAL_PCT, ...), i.e. max mana exactly as the tooltip promises. Learning the passive self-casts it (Player::addSpell, Player.cpp:3384). Both effects are unconditional and multiplicative on the player's current totals, so attack_power and max_power(power=0) read directly via ratio_to a pre-learn snapshot, with a rounding tolerance around the exact 1.10 multiplier. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
